exposure.needed: whether any Kafka cluster managed by Strimzi is still ZooKeeper-based rather than KRaft; the evidence does not say which configuration identifies a ZooKeeper-based cluster

consequence.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 no longer supports ZooKeeper-based clusters or migrating them from ZooKeeper to KRaft, so every cluster has to be on KRaft before the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Migrate all ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft using a Strimzi version older than 0.46.0, then upgrade to 0.46.0.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 drops support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration, so all clusters must be on KRaft before upgrading.
